headline: Youth commission advances press release and youth group plans

meeting.summary: The commission approved its June minutes, moved a press release forward, and planned a flyer for a youth advisory group.
meeting.recap: The Commission on Children and Youth was called to order at 2:32 on July 20, 2026.[[0:00:31]] A youth testifier said she is leaving the proposed youth advisory group.[[0:03:52]] The commission approved its June 22, 2026 minutes, seven to zero.[[0:07:45]] The secretary said any commission budget request paperwork is due by the end of September.[[0:09:00]] The chair offered to draft a letter requesting funds for printed materials and training.[[0:17:21]] The commission voted seven to zero to move the revised press release forward.[[0:37:41]] A motion let the vice chair collect information at a youth summit on behalf of the commission.[[0:48:54]] A commissioner offered to help start the community-led youth advisory group.[[1:02:38]] A commissioner agreed to create a flyer for the group and bring it to the next meeting.[[1:10:14]] The chair will bring a list of website changes for approval at the next meeting.[[1:26:11]] The meeting adjourned at 3:59 p.m.[[1:27:00]]
decided: The commission approved the June 22, 2026 minutes as presented.
The motion passed, but the count was not clearly stated.
The commission approved sending the revised press release forward, with the drafting commissioner able to work with the department's communications staff.
With no objection, the chair moved agenda item eight ahead of item seven.
meeting.next: The chair will draft a letter requesting funds and bring it to the next meeting. A Child Welfare Services presentation was tabled to the next meeting. The vice chair offered to report back on the youth summit, possibly at the next meeting. A youth group flyer may be added to the next meeting's agenda if a copy is ready. A new brochure draft will be prepared for the next meeting. The chair will develop a list of website changes for approval at the next meeting.
